Prevention: Treat seed with fungicide or hot water at 47°C for 1/2 hour prior to sowing.
Avoid the use of heavy organic material as fertilizer during the rainy season.
Planting on raised beds will help drainage and reduce disease pressure.
Monitoring: Monitor plants, early signs of yellowing and leaf spot of lower leaves indicates presence of disease
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Remove and dispose of diseased leaves, the fungi can survive on leaves and stem throughout the plants life.
Avoid excessive moisture reduce irrigation and avoid wetting plants on evenings.
If disease is present, avoid working in area when plants are wet
Apply appropriate foliar fungicides. e.g.Serenade 1-3 tbsp /gall.
Direct Control (Chemical): Wear appropriate protection when using chemical sprays.
Serenade is considered non-toxic but avoid the spray and avoid becoming contaminated.
Change the chemical control regularly to prevent the fungus becoming resistant to the chemical.
Apply appropriate foliar fungicides such as the systemic copper containing chemical.
